The tag picker works: searchable existing tags, a "Create new tag" option when adding, and for removing only the tags actually on your selection.

Reload **http://maker:4001** (or the big set `?demo=big`).

**Re-check bulk tagging with the new picker.** Select a few cards, then:

1. Click **"Add tag…"** — a small dialog opens with a **search box** and your **existing tags** as a list. Type `jav` to see it narrow to "javascript"; type something new like `to-read` and you'll get **"+ Create new tag: 'to-read'"**. Click a tag (or the create option) to apply it to all selected — existing tags are reused case-insensitively.
2. Select a few again and click **"Remove tag…"** — the dialog lists **only the tags that are actually on your selected bookmarks**, so you can pick one to strip. 
3. Click outside the dialog or **Cancel** to dismiss without changes.

Does the tag picker match what you had in mind (searchable suggestions, create-on-add, present-only on remove)? If so, bulk actions are settled and we'll move to **saved searches** (a search plus included/excluded tags you can reuse).
